bio: A journey through the lovely Liège countryside, the owner’s delightful welcome and chef Claes’ scrumptious dishes: get ready to treat yourself from start to finish, safe in the knowledge you are in the hands of an experienced and accomplished chef. You may taste a flawlessly fresh fillet of whiting flanked by an elegant beurre blanc. No compromise on quality is ever tolerated, all the better because the prices make sense....
